title: T5 Calibration Method & Evaluation Protocol Design

frozen_protocol.predictive_quantity: Task-specific probability of the frozen T5 duplicate target.

calibration_metrics.class_imbalance_context: Average Precision is retained because the T5 validation population is highly imbalanced.

interpretation.Brier_score: Measures squared probabilistic error for the binary duplicate target; lower is better.
interpretation.Log_loss: Measures logarithmic probabilistic error for the binary duplicate target; lower is better.
interpretation.ECE: Summarizes the discrepancy between predicted probability and observed event frequency across probability bins. It is a diagnostic summary, not a standalone proof of calibration.
interpretation.MCE: Captures the largest observed calibration-bin discrepancy and is treated as a supporting diagnostic.
interpretation.ROC_AUC: Measures ranking discrimination and is not a calibration metric.
interpretation.Average_Precision: Measures precision-recall ranking behavior and is not a calibration metric.

class_imbalance.handling: Do not alter the native target prevalence merely to make calibration appear balanced.
class_imbalance.interpretation: Calibration must be evaluated against the actual validation population and its observed prevalence.

calibration_method_policy.principle: Calibration method must be selected according to the frozen protocol and evidence, not according to an outcome discovered after unrestricted experimentation.
calibration_method_policy.important_constraint: The later empirical operation must not introduce an arbitrary calibration method solely because it produces the most favorable observed metric.

uncertainty.purpose: Quantify uncertainty around reported calibration and evaluation estimates rather than presenting single-point metrics as exact quantities.
uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: Validation observations, with the resampling procedure preserving the binary observation structure.
uncertainty.minimum_requirement: Point estimates should be accompanied by an appropriate uncertainty interval where feasible.

reliability_analysis.binning: Use predefined probability bins for reliability analysis rather than choosing bins after inspecting the resulting calibration curve.
reliability_analysis.minimum_bin_support: Sparse bins must be reported explicitly rather than silently treated as equally reliable.
reliability_analysis.interpretation: Reliability diagrams are descriptive diagnostics and must not be used alone to declare a model calibrated.

threshold_policy.reason: Calibration estimates the quality of probability values. It does not by itself establish an automation or human-review operating threshold.

data_boundary.principle: The locked test population remains isolated from calibration fitting and methodological selection.

group_structure.principle: T5's established group-aware structure must remain part of the interpretation of calibration evidence.
group_structure.prohibited: Do not treat structurally dependent duplicate examples as independent evidence merely because they occupy separate rows.

cross_task_restrictions.statement: T5 calibration produces a T5 duplicate-probability quantity only. It does not establish a confidence or risk quantity comparable to T2, T4, T6, or T7.

next_operation_requirements: Load only the frozen T5 population and native outputs.
Apply only the calibration procedures permitted by the frozen protocol.
Report discrimination metrics as supporting context.
Do not select an automation threshold.
Do not create a universal confidence/risk score.
Do not use locked test data for method selection.

decision: T5 calibration/evaluation methodology is frozen for the subsequent empirical operation. The next operation may execute the predefined protocol, but may not alter the methodology opportunistically after observing calibration results.
